summary: Refuse legacy-start repair when procfs can hide live producers

schema.detail: No storage, evidence, or replicated receipt schema changes.

rules.detail: No claim admission or projection rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Repair now fails closed with HTTP 422 legacy-start-proof-unavailable, stage procfs-visibility, when the actual procfs mount has hidepid other than 0/off (including 1, 2, invisible, noaccess, or ptraceable), or subset=pid. It also refuses unreadable, malformed, or missing mount evidence with a distinct reason. Normal procfs behavior is unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal restart; no migration or rebuild.

manual.detail: No automatic configuration changes. Hosts whose procfs can hide processes cannot use legacy-start repair until complete process visibility is established.

recovery.detail: Refusal changes no runtime or store state. Earlier binaries do not enforce this procfs visibility precondition.
